note: `config/dotenv.exs` calls `System.put_env/2` under `:dev` and `:test`, overwriting `ARCA_CLI_CONFIG_PATH` from the parent environment, so a child cannot be steered by exporting it. The seam sets it inside the evaluated code, after config evaluation. Without this test a child that never reached the broken config would produce plausible-looking failures.
